family.architecture_note: Released decision path uses a Qwen backbone plus a joint schema head and custom joint_schema_model.py.

clef_flash.freeze_gate: Resolve and record the full immutable HF commit SHA before the first local model output.

hosted_workers_ai.documented_long_state_behavior: Long text state is truncated to fit the model token limit.
hosted_workers_ai.provenance_note: Hosted runs can freeze alias, request, API surface and observation time, but not an immutable underlying model revision unless Cloudflare exposes one.

local_release.runtime_boundary: Generic chat-generation examples are not treated as evidence that vLLM/SGLang exercise the Clef joint decision head.

upstream_benchmarks.note: Do not report Cloudflare/TypeSafe head-to-head numbers as Lab reproduction.

architecture_training.backbone_policy: Cloudflare states the Qwen backbone is frozen while the routing head and rank-256 low-rank adapters are jointly optimized.
architecture_training.inference_shape: A specialized two-stage attention routing process scores schema choices directly from internal representations rather than autoregressive answer text.
architecture_training.joint_cross_field_attention: Upstream states field parameters may cross-attend with other fields and back to the payload before scoring. Treat question isolation as an empirical property, not an assumption.
architecture_training.rlcd: Cloudflare describes a secondary Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Decisions stage with partial credit for adjacent ordinal choices, exact-record reward, and a reference penalty against distribution shift.
research_implications: Packed-vs-separate question stability is high priority.
Option/field order sensitivity remains a measured property even though upstream synthetic data permuted order.
Score/ordinal calibration deserves separate analysis from Choice/Noul.

compatibility_boundary.upstream_claim: Cloudflare states Clef follows the System One API and existing Jev integrations can switch by changing endpoint and model.
compatibility_boundary.local_body_compatibility: Released joint_schema_model.py:systemone explicitly accepts a Jev/SystemOne POST /v1/systemone request body and returns the same response-body shape.
compatibility_boundary.workers_ai_transport: Direct hosted examples use Workers AI binding AI.run(...) or the Cloudflare REST /accounts/{account_id}/ai/run/@cf/cloudflare/{model} transport.
compatibility_boundary.classification_until_verified: System One request/response compatible; hosted transport adapter expected unless an exact /v1/systemone-compatible endpoint is independently verified.
compatibility_boundary.research_implication: Measure application changes, adapter-only changes, and provider/runtime configuration changes separately. Do not collapse schema compatibility into HTTP endpoint compatibility.
